Hello all,

I am part of an after school club in England and we are looking for some advice on creating Holograms. We were given little funding and no help at all and asked to find out what we need from the internet so forgive me if I sound a little stupid.

What we are looking to do is create hologram stickers for kids to transfer onto certificates as well as creating the glass ornaments that look really cool but our main focus is on the stickers with a picture that can be seen.

Thanks in advance.
